acquisition.interface: wikidot.py Page metadata populated by the live ListPages response

analysis: Live Wikidot exposes a structured identity tuple for each populated lifecycle user: numeric Wikidot user ID, display name, and unix name.

The frozen SCP corpus metadata retains only the display-name string for created_by, updated_by, and commented_by. The loss occurs in the corpus adapter, which stringifies the user object even though the local wikidot.py object retains all three identity fields.

Imported ListPages identity variables therefore require additive structured provenance fields in refreshed corpus metadata. Wikijump must consume those fields without substituting the local importer account.
